title: Voldemort, Gotham City and the Greens: Victorian election gets a jolt of life as leaders face off in sole debate
summary_full: Ben Carroll, Jess Wilson, Ellen Sandell and Warren Pickering grilled by undecided voters – and each other – as state prepares to head to the pollsFor a brief moment on Tuesday night, the Victorian election looked like it might actually get interesting.Two weeks into the offical campaign, with early voting opening on Wednesday, the contest has been pretty short on excitement. The Labor government has continued to slide in the polls, while the Coalition opposition has largely been focused on not getting in its own way for long enough to cruise to victory.
